# Slapshot (Eye Black)

Slapshot is the turquoise unicorn on Braeburn’s Appleloosa buckball team in G4’s *Friendship Is Magic*. Think of her as Snails’ opposing basket-catcher: a competitive-looking athlete with a swept dark slate-blue mane, golden eyes, black sports stripes beneath her eyes and a red jersey with gold trim.

[![Slapshot at right with her teammates — Hasbro Studios, Buckball Season (2016)](https://reviewersunite.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/mlps6e18-9.jpg?w=656)](https://reviewersunite.com/2016/09/04/super-recaps-my-little-pony-season-6-buckball-season/)

- **Naming:** Slapshot is a fandom name documented by [November 2018](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/418498/16/good-trooper-gilda/afternoon-on-the-firing-line). Eye Black and Appleloosa Buckball Unicorn are alternative [fandom labels](https://twibooru.org/tags/eye%2Bblack). The latter two refer to her sports makeup and team. No official personal name or original namer was verified.
- **Speaking status:** No identifiable spoken lines or individual voice credit were found. See the [episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?p=188227).
- **Appearances:** Her verified television appearance is *Buckball Season* (S6E18, September 3, 2016; [official episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/buckball-season/umc.cmc.2ivkxr1n7c0txwr7vgumw7t11)). She is a genuine character in G4 television continuity, although her names are not verified as official. No further episode, film or comic appearance was confirmed.

## Important moments

- **Appleloosa’s challenger — Buckball Season (S6E18).** She fills the unicorn position on Braeburn’s team, using a levitated basket to catch the team’s shots and providing the counterpart to Snails.
- **A narrow defeat — Buckball Season (S6E18).** Appleloosa loses 6–5 to Ponyville, and her visibly disappointed expression contrasts with the winners’ celebration; it is her most recognizable character beat.

Both moments occur in the final match of the [official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JbIx2afSePc); exact timestamps are unavailable because playback could not be verified. No independently attributable fan artwork or further character-defining scenes were verified.
